name: limit_rib_outside_its_plane
why: ENTRY W1.2. The L of the twin and the same diagonal, but written at z = 20 while the requested plane is the front one offset by 25. A line that is not on the plane cannot be drawn on that plane: projecting it in silence would mean making the rib in a different place from the one requested. It is refused BEFORE touching the part (no plane, no sketch) and it says by how much it is off and what to change.
_the_numbers: Deviation: |20 - 25| = 5 mm, beyond the 0.05 tolerance (the same margin as sketched_bend).
